list.name: Changes
list.comment:
fix: enforce SERVING_NOTICE eligibility, close stale-session auth gap, repair KPI/training schema drift
Auth / session: - hydrate_request_actor_roles now fails closed (marks the account inactive) if the live DB status/role lookup errors, instead of silently falling back to the stale JWT claim — closes a gap where a transient DB hiccup could let an actor keep acting on a status that changed after their token was issued. - Gate leave_request, wfh, comp_off, optional_leave, and timelog routers behind require_onboarding_complete so INVITED/ONBOARDING users can't bypass the frontend's OnboardingGate via a direct API call.
Employment status coverage (ACTIVE-only checks missing SERVING_NOTICE): - allocation_repository: manager/approver/unallocated-user lookups now include SERVING_NOTICE alongside ACTIVE. - timelog_categories: manager picker includes SERVING_NOTICE. - scheduled_jobs_service: auto-approver selection includes SERVING_NOTICE.
Other correctness fixes: - work_profile: technical-role regex now matches "analyst" roles. - timelog_service: use format_display_date instead of raw isoformat() for CSV/XLSX export and submission messages. - wk_business_http: map upstream 404s to a clear "not recognized" 404 instead of a generic 502. - employee_service: import_user_data and bulk_upload_users now run the exit-status/date validation and exit-survey dispatch on status changes, matching the single-update path.
Schema drift repair (guarded migrations for legacy Java-seeded tables): - Recreate missing training_* enum types when the tables predate this app's own migrations. - Add kpi_definitions.evaluation_criteria, which no migration ever actually created despite the model assuming it existed. - Add B4L/B4H/B5L/B5H bands, mirroring the existing B6L/B6H/B7L/B7H split.
Also adds app/core/upload_limits.py to raise Starlette's undocumented 1MB multipart part-size cap, wired in on startup.
